"Careers of the species and their d100 roll. 'Chance' is the weight of each checked career ('X' or '-' = not rolled). 'Min-Max' is the slice of the d100 it gets: careers are sorted by class then name, and slices are stretched to 100 if the total is not 100 (see 'Total weight'). '% class' is the chance of landing in the career's class: the sum of the slices of all careers of that class (empty class = all careers are one group)."

"Skills (or talents) given by a species. Several checked lines = ALL are given (AND). To offer a choice (OR), e.g. Trade (Miner) or Trade (Smith): right-click the line, 'Add' creates another line of the same skill, pick a specialisation in each line and check it, then right-click one line > 'Merge' and pick the other: they become one choice. 'Split' turns a choice back into separate lines, 'Remove' takes one option out of a choice, 'Delete' removes the line."
